_comment: The example relevance settings. Copy to <helm home>/_global/relevance.json
and edit: this file is documentation and is never read at runtime.
mode: off (the default when the file is absent), shadow (score every turn,
log what the classifier would keep, change nothing delivered) or live (the
scored order replaces keyword order; a turn whose score missed the wait
bound is delivered in keyword order and carries one marker word).
wait_s bounds the hook's wait in live mode, never the score: a late score
still lands in the per-turn cache a later read takes (`helm relevance
show` today). Values above 3 s are ignored.
local_by_choice: projects that MAY leave the LAN but should be scored by the
local head; honoured only while `helm relevance remeasure` has passed for
the head the service serves. Residency itself is a registry field
(`helm projects residency`), never a list here.
The scorer service's URL is the `relevance` key of endpoints.json.
